rows.en: ＊Yoh＊I could talk with you forever,￥but we've gotta train too.￥Shall we get started?＞

＊Yoh＊We came here to train, so￥no more sitting around talking.￥Let's start.＞
＊Yoh＊Shall we start today's￥training?￥Let's both give it our all!＞
